# FMC refresh visual comparisons

Before screenshots use upstream commit `76f608abccca561c34f793c47e6578db2142f3de`.
After screenshots show the branding and Watch Frame changes in this pull request.

Desktop captures use a 1440 × 900 viewport; mobile captures use 390 × 844. Both use the dark color scheme. The editor comparisons use the same Progress Day watch face fixture from the test suite.

The Open Graph images are 1200 × 630. The Watch Frame screenshots show Watch 3 Pro with Orange selected. Model and color changes apply immediately while the panel remains open.
